title: Relative associated primes over an affine chart detect relative associated points of the sheaf
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma relates the relative associated primes of the module of sections over a pair of affine charts to the relative associated points of the sheaf, with the converse requiring finitely generated fibre primes, which is the case when all fibres are locally Noetherian (statement lines 1078-1095). The counted proof is short and complete: it converts the algebraic condition into an associatedness condition on the base change of the module to the residue field of the image point, identifies that base change with the restriction of the fibrewise sheaf, and applies the affine description of associated points on the fibre; the converse is reduced to the finite generation of the fibre prime (proof lines 1097-1117). It is H2: the argument is carried out in the counted span and its inputs are the standard relative associated prime comparison and the affine description of associated points.
